passages.text: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.
passages.sermon:
Judah was one of Jacob’s sons.
At that time, Judah left his brothers.
Judah went down from them.
Judah stayed near a man named Hirah.
Hirah was from Adullam.
Hirah was an Adullamite.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֥רֶד יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת אֶחָ֑יו וַיֵּ֛ט עַד־ אִ֥ישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ חִירָֽה׃

passages.text: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.
passages.sermon:
Judah was one of Jacob’s sons.
Judah left his brothers.
Judah went to live near a man named Hirah.
Hirah was from Adullam.
Judah saw a woman there.
She was the daughter of a Canaanite man.
The Canaanite man’s name was Shua.
Judah took Shua’s daughter as his wife.
Judah slept with her.
passages.original: וַיַּרְא־ שָׁ֧ם יְהוּדָ֛ה בַּת־ אִ֥ישׁ כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ שׁ֑וּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and Judah named him Er.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the son of Jacob.
Judah married the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua.
Judah’s wife became pregnant.
She gave birth to a son.
Judah named his son Er.
passages.original: וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵֽר׃

passages.text: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.
passages.sermon:
Judah’s wife was the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua.
She conceived again.
She gave birth to a son.
She named him Onan.
passages.original: וַתַּ֥הַר ע֖וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אוֹנָֽן׃

passages.text: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
passages.sermon:
Judah’s wife became pregnant again.
She gave birth to another son.
She named him Shelah.
She gave birth to Shelah at Chezib.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֤סֶף עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה בִכְזִ֖יב בְּלִדְתָּ֥הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
passages.sermon:
Judah had a son named Er.
Er was Judah’s firstborn son.
Judah found a wife for Er.
The wife’s name was Tamar.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֧ח יְהוּדָ֛ה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְעֵ֣ר בְּכוֹר֑וֹ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ תָּמָֽר׃

passages.text: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so the LORD put him to death.
passages.sermon:
Er was Judah’s firstborn son.
Er did evil things.
The LORD saw Er’s wickedness.
The LORD put Er to death.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְמִתֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”
passages.sermon:
Judah was the father of Onan.
Onan was Judah’s son.
Judah spoke to Onan.
Judah said, “Go to your brother’s wife.”
Judah told Onan to marry his brother’s widow.
Judah commanded Onan to act as a brother-in-law.
Judah told Onan to have children with her.
Judah said these children would belong to Onan’s brother.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ לְאוֹנָ֔ן בֹּ֛א אֶל־ אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יךָ וְיַבֵּ֣ם אֹתָ֑הּ וְהָקֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: But Onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother’s wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.
passages.sermon:
Onan was Judah’s son.
Onan knew something important.
He knew the child would not be his.
He slept with his brother’s wife.
He spilled his seed on the ground.
He did this so he would not give a child to his brother.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע אוֹנָ֔ן כִּ֛י לֹּ֥א ל֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַזָּ֑רַע וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־ בָּ֨א אֶל־ אֵ֤שֶׁת אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת אַ֔רְצָה לְבִלְתִּ֥י נְתָן־ זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיו׃

passages.text: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD, so He put Onan to death as well.
passages.sermon:
Onan did something wicked.
The LORD saw what Onan did.
The LORD judged Onan’s actions as evil.
The LORD put Onan to death.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֛רַע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיָּ֖מֶת גַּם־ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the father-in-law of Tamar.
Judah spoke to Tamar.
Judah told Tamar to live as a widow in her father’s house.
Judah said she should stay there until his son Shelah grew up.
Judah thought, “Shelah may die too, like his brothers.”
Tamar went to her father’s house.
Tamar lived there.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְתָמָ֨ר כַּלָּת֜וֹ שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית־ אָבִ֗יךְ עַד־ יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔י כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־ יָמ֥וּת גַּם־ ה֖וּא כְּאֶחָ֑יו וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֔ר וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ׃

passages.text: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had finished mourning, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the son of Jacob.
Judah’s wife was the daughter of Shua.
A long time passed.
Judah’s wife died.
Judah mourned for his wife.
Judah finished mourning.
Judah had a friend named Hirah.
Hirah was from Adullam.
Judah and Hirah went to Timnah.
They went to visit Judah’s sheepshearers.
passages.original: וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתָּ֖מָת בַּת־ שׁ֣וּעַ אֵֽשֶׁת־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּ֜עַל עַל־ גֹּֽזֲזֵ֤י צֹאנוֹ֙ ה֗וּא וְחִירָ֛ה רֵעֵ֥הוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִ֖י תִּמְנָֽתָה׃

passages.text: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,” she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
passages.sermon:
Tamar was Judah’s daughter-in-law.
Someone told Tamar, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
Tamar took off her widow’s clothes.
She covered her face with a veil.
She disguised herself.
She sat at the entrance to Enaim.
Enaim is on the road to Timnah.
Tamar saw that Shelah had grown up.
Judah had not given Shelah to her as a husband.
passages.original: וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְתָמָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֥ה חָמִ֛יךְ עֹלֶ֥ה תִמְנָ֖תָה לָגֹ֥ז צֹאנֽוֹ׃ וַתָּסַר֩ בִּגְדֵ֨י אַלְמְנוּתָ֜הּ מֵֽעָלֶ֗יהָ וַתְּכַ֤ס בַּצָּעִיף֙ וַתִּתְעַלָּ֔ף וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח עֵינַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תִּמְנָ֑תָה כִּ֤י רָאֲתָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָדַ֣ל שֵׁלָ֔ה וְהִ֕וא לֹֽא־ נִתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the son of Jacob.
Judah saw Tamar.
Tamar was his daughter-in-law.
Judah did not recognize Tamar.
Tamar had covered her face with a veil.
Judah thought Tamar was a prostitute.
He thought this because her face was covered.
passages.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣הָ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיַּחְשְׁבֶ֖הָ לְזוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֥י כִסְּתָ֖ה פָּנֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.” “What will you give me for sleeping with you?” she inquired.
passages.sermon:
Judah saw Tamar.
Judah did not know Tamar was his daughter-in-law.
Judah went over to Tamar by the road.
Judah said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.”
Tamar replied, “What will you give me for sleeping with you?”
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨ט אֵלֶ֜יהָ אֶל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽבָה־ נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖וֹ הִ֑וא וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ לִּ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: “I will send you a young goat from my flock,” Judah answered. But she replied, “Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.”
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to the woman.
Judah said, “I will send you a young goat from my flock.”
The woman replied to Judah.
She said, “You must give me a pledge until you send it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֛י אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח גְּדִֽי־ עִזִּ֖ים מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר אִם־ תִּתֵּ֥ן עֵרָב֖וֹן עַ֥ד שָׁלְחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: “What pledge should I give you?” he asked. She answered, “Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.” So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a man from the family of Jacob.
Tamar was his daughter-in-law.
Judah did not know that the woman was Tamar.
Judah wanted to sleep with her.
Judah asked, “What pledge should I give you?”
Tamar answered, “Your seal, your cord, and the staff in your hand.”
Judah gave Tamar his seal, his cord, and his staff.
Judah slept with Tamar.
Tamar became pregnant by Judah.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָֽעֵרָבוֹן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן־ לָּךְ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ֙ וּפְתִילֶ֔ךָ וּמַטְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־ לָּ֛הּ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וַתַּ֥הַר לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.
passages.sermon:
Tamar was a widow.
Tamar stood up.
Tamar left the place.
Tamar took off her veil.
Tamar put on her widow’s clothes again.
passages.original: וַתָּ֣קָם וַתֵּ֔לֶךְ וַתָּ֥סַר צְעִיפָ֖הּ מֵעָלֶ֑יהָ וַתִּלְבַּ֖שׁ בִּגְדֵ֥י אַלְמְנוּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the son of Jacob.
Judah sent a young goat to a woman.
Judah gave the goat to his friend Hirah.
Hirah was from Adullam.
Judah wanted Hirah to get his items back from the woman.
Judah had left his seal, cord, and staff with the woman.
Hirah went to find the woman.
Hirah could not find her.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶת־ גְּדִ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ רֵעֵ֣הוּ הָֽעֲדֻלָּמִ֔י לָקַ֥חַת הָעֵרָב֖וֹן מִיַּ֣ד הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹ֖א מְצָאָֽהּ׃

passages.text: He asked the men of that place, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?” “No shrine prostitute has been here,” they answered.
passages.sermon:
Hirah was Judah’s friend.
\r\nHirah went to the town.
\r\nHirah spoke to the men who lived there.
\r\nHirah asked them a question.
\r\nHe said, “Where is the shrine prostitute?”
\r\nHe said, “She was beside the road at Enaim.”
\r\nThe men answered him.
\r\nThey said, “No shrine prostitute has been here.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֤י מְקֹמָהּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַיֵּ֧ה הַקְּדֵשָׁ֛ה הִ֥וא בָעֵינַ֖יִם עַל־ הַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Hirah was Judah’s friend from Adullam.
Hirah returned to Judah.
Hirah spoke to Judah.
Hirah said, “I could not find her.”
Hirah also said, “The men of that place told me, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ אֶל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֑יהָ וְגַ֨ם אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”
passages.sermon:
Judah was the father-in-law of Tamar.
Judah spoke to his friend Hirah.
Judah said, “Let her keep the items.”
Judah wanted to avoid shame.
Judah said, “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock.”
Judah explained his actions.
Judah said, “I did send her this young goat.”
Judah said, “But you could not find her.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָ֔הּ פֶּ֖ן נִהְיֶ֣ה לָב֑וּז הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁלַ֙חְתִּי֙ הַגְּדִ֣י הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א מְצָאתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: About three months later, Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.” “Bring her out!” Judah replied. “Let her be burned to death!”
passages.sermon:
Judah was the father-in-law of Tamar.
About three months passed.
Someone told Judah about Tamar.
They said, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has acted as a prostitute.”
They also said, “She is now pregnant because of this.”
Judah heard this news.
Judah said, “Bring her out.”
Judah said, “Let her be burned to death.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּמִשְׁלֹ֣שׁ חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִֽיהוּדָ֤ה לֵֽאמֹר֙ זָֽנְתָה֙ תָּמָ֣ר כַּלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְגַ֛ם הִנֵּ֥ה הָרָ֖ה לִזְנוּנִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֔ה הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵֽף׃

passages.text: As she was being brought out, Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.” And she added, “Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?”
passages.sermon:
Tamar was Judah’s daughter-in-law.
People brought Tamar out to be punished.
Tamar sent a message to Judah, her father-in-law.
She said, “I am pregnant by the man who owns these items.”
She showed the seal, the cord, and the staff.
She said, “Please look at these.”
She asked, “Whose seal, cord, and staff are these?”
passages.original: הִ֣וא מוּצֵ֗את וְהִ֨יא שָׁלְחָ֤ה אֶל־ חָמִ֙יהָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֣לֶּה לּ֔וֹ אָנֹכִ֖י הָרָ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַכֶּר־ נָ֔א לְמִ֞י הַחֹתֶ֧מֶת וְהַפְּתִילִ֛ים וְהַמַּטֶּ֖ה הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Judah recognized the items and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not have relations with her again.
passages.sermon:
Judah saw the items.
He recognized them.
He said, “She is more righteous than I am.”
He said this because he did not give Tamar to his son Shelah.
Judah did not have relations with Tamar again.
passages.original: וַיַּכֵּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ צָֽדְקָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔נִּי כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן לֹא־ נְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְשֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְדַעְתָּֽה׃

passages.text: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
passages.sermon:
Tamar was a woman.
Tamar became pregnant.
The time came for Tamar to give birth.
Tamar was ready to deliver her children.
Tamar had twins in her womb.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֖י בְּעֵ֣ת לִדְתָּ֑הּ וְהִנֵּ֥ה תְאוֹמִ֖ים בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. “This one came out first,” she announced.
passages.sermon:
Tamar was giving birth to twins.
One baby put out his hand.
The midwife saw the hand.
The midwife took a scarlet thread.
She tied the scarlet thread around the baby's wrist.
The midwife said, "This one came out first."
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י בְלִדְתָּ֖הּ וַיִּתֶּן־ יָ֑ד וַתִּקַּ֣ח הַמְיַלֶּ֗דֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עַל־ יָד֤וֹ שָׁנִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֖ה יָצָ֥א רִאשֹׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.
passages.sermon:
Tamar was giving birth to twins.
One baby put out his hand first.
The midwife tied a scarlet thread on his wrist.
Then he pulled his hand back.
His brother came out instead.
The midwife saw this.
She said, “You have broken out first!”
They named him Perez.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּמֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ וְהִנֵּה֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־ פָּרַ֖צְתָּ עָלֶ֣יךָ פָּ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ פָּֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.
passages.sermon:
A baby boy was born.
He was the second son in this birth.
He had a scarlet thread tied around his wrist.
His family named him Zerah.
passages.original: וְאַחַר֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ יָד֖וֹ הַשָּׁנִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ זָֽרַח׃ס
